title: Move Papyrus's CLI login into the library without breaking Mac sessions
description: Owner: Papyrus session. Move src/papyrus_content/cli_user_auth.py and macos_keychain.py into anthus_cli_login (target, oauth, session, locks, stores/macos), behind a product target the caller supplies. Keep Keychain SERVICE 'papyrus-newsroom-oauth' and the per-site keys, so existing Mac sessions renew unchanged; keep Papyrus's behaviour and port its specs (features_backend/cli-user-auth.feature) as Gherkin here. Done when Papyrus's specs pass against the library with no behaviour change.
